sync.enableAutoSyncHint: Pull new recordings from your Plaud device on a fixed schedule.
sync.onMountHint: Automatically sync when the app first loads.
sync.onVisibilityHint: Sync when you return to the app tab.

playback.autoplayHint: Start the next recording as soon as the current one ends.
playback.scrubberHint: Waveform draws the audio amplitude and decodes in the browser on the first listen. Progress bar is a plain slider that needs no decoding.
playback.shortcutsHint: Available when the player has focus.

display.itemsPerPageHint: How many recordings to show on each page (10-100)

notifications.browserHint: Pop up a desktop notification whenever new recordings come in or a sync runs.
notifications.emailHint: Send email notifications for new recordings.
notifications.barkHint: Push new recordings to your phone through Bark.
notifications.soundHint: Play a short chime as notifications come in.
notifications.marketingHint: The occasional email about new features and releases. At most a few each year, and never more than one a month.
notifications.usingAccountEmail: Using your account email. You can point this elsewhere if you prefer.
notifications.testFailed: The test email could not be sent
notifications.barkHelp: Paste the full push URL from your Bark app (e.g., https://api.day.app/your_key).

storage.largestHint: Play a recording before you decide to delete it
storage.backendFixed: The storage backend is set for the whole instance through environment variables.
storage.autoDeleteHint: Delete recordings automatically once they pass the retention period.
storage.retentionHint: Anything older than this gets deleted automatically (1-365 days)

export.formatMp3Description: Converted to MP3 for easy playback.
export.formatOggDescription: Ogg container with Opus audio. Smaller files than MP3.
export.formatOriginalDescription: Saved exactly as recorded. Opus audio keeps its bytes and is named .ogg.
export.nameOriginalDescription: Keep the name from Plaud or the uploaded file.
export.nameAiDescription: Renamed to the AI title once transcription finishes.
export.summaryOriginal: Save each new recording as its original file in a folder on this Mac.
export.summaryOgg: Save each new recording as an OGG (Opus) file in a folder on this Mac.
export.summaryMp3: Save each new recording as an MP3 in a folder on this Mac.
export.exportFailed: The export could not be saved
export.exportHint: "Export text" downloads your transcripts and summaries in the default format. It does not include audio.
export.onboardingRestartHint: Start onboarding over and see it again the next time you visit
export.autoExportHint: Save each new recording into a folder. Only the desktop app can write files.
export.autoExportDesktopHint: Export new recordings on their own as they are synced
export.exportFolderHint: Each new recording is written to this folder once, when it arrives.
export.folderPickerFailed: Could not open the folder picker.

desktop.launchAtLoginHint: Start OpenAudioHub when you sign in to your Mac. It starts without a window and stays in the menu bar.
desktop.notAvailable: The desktop app is not available.
desktop.languageHint: The interface language is chosen in the account menu and applies to the menu bar item as well.

ai.autoTranscribeHint: Transcribe new recordings on their own as soon as they arrive from your Plaud device
ai.importPlaudHint: If Plaud already transcribed a recording, bring its transcript and summary over on the next sync instead of spending a provider call on it again.
ai.keepBoth: Keep both — also run my provider
ai.defaultLanguageHint: Language to use for transcription. Auto-detect will identify the language automatically.
ai.speakerLabelsHint: Breaks the transcript down by speaker (Speaker 1:, Speaker 2:). Used by ElevenLabs Scribe and by diarizing OpenAI models; other providers ignore it.
ai.expectedSpeakersHint: A hint, not a hard limit. Auto works well for most recordings.
ai.qualityHint: Balance between transcription speed and accuracy
ai.qualityBalancedHint: Good balance of speed and accuracy
ai.defaultPromptHint: The prompt that new summaries start from. You can override this per-recording.
ai.outputLanguageHint: Applies to AI-generated summaries and titles. Auto follows whatever language the transcript is in.
ai.autoSummarizeHint: Runs after every successful transcription — manual, auto-sync, or re-transcribe. Switch on Auto-transcribe to cover recordings that arrive through sync as well. Uses one extra AI provider call per summary.
ai.noPrompts: No custom prompts yet. Create one to get started.
ai.promptSaveFailed: Failed to save prompt. Changes reverted.
ai.promptDeleteFailed: Failed to delete prompt. Changes reverted.
ai.deletePromptBody: Recordings you already summarized with this prompt keep their summaries, but you won't be able to run it again.
ai.createSummaryPrompt: Write your own prompt for generating summaries. Use {placeholder} as a placeholder for the transcription text. Ask for a JSON object with summary, keyPoints, and actionItems fields.
ai.createTitlePrompt: Create a custom prompt for title generation. Use {placeholder} as a placeholder for the transcription text.
ai.nameOriginalHint: Keep the name from Plaud or the uploaded file.
ai.nameAiHint: Generate a title from the transcript after transcription finishes.
ai.syncTitleHint: Send generated titles back to the Plaud device and rename the file there
ai.dateTitlesHint: Earlier versions named date titles with the time added. Check the list, then choose which to shorten to the date.

presets.generalHint: Overview, key points, topics, and follow-ups for any recording
presets.meetingHint: Attendees, discussion, decisions, and an owner, task, and due date for each action item
presets.interviewHint: Background, questions and answers, pain points, quotes with timestamps, and insights
presets.callHint: Purpose, requests, commitments, agreed next steps, and open issues
presets.lectureHint: Outline, core concepts, examples, pitfalls, and review questions
presets.brainstormHint: Ideas grouped by theme, trade-offs, ideas set aside, and next experiments
presets.voiceMemoHint: Main points, ideas, quotes, resources mentioned, and to-dos
presets.keyPointsHint: A one-sentence overview and five to fifteen key points
presets.actionItemsHint: Owner, task, due date, and status for every action item

providers.emptyBody: Add a provider to transcribe recordings and write summaries.
providers.deleteBody: This erases the stored API key for the provider. Recordings transcribed or summarized through it keep their data, but you'll need to re-add the provider to use it again.
providers.providerRequired: Provider and API key are required
providers.apiKeyHintExisting: The saved key is hidden and cannot be read back. Leave it blank to keep the current key, or paste a new one to replace it.
providers.activePromptHint: Pick the prompt for generating titles
providers.noCustomPrompts: No custom prompts yet. Create one to get started.
providers.modelHintList: Pick a transcription model. Choose Custom… to enter a model id that isn't listed.
providers.modelHintDynamic: Only audio-input models are shown. Transcription uses chat-completions; mp3/wav recordings only.
providers.modelHintNeedKey: Enter your API key to load the model list.
